statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-16 on the Komga 1.30.1 source (tag 1.30.1). The flaw needs XsltView rendering a view whose name is not explicitly specified under a "/**" mapping. Komga renders views with Thymeleaf only (komga/build.gradle.kts:71 spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf); no XsltView or XsltViewResolver is configured anywhere in the source, and its only wildcard view mappings return explicit view names (komga/src/main/kotlin/org/gotson/komga/interfaces/mvc/IndexController.kt:25-28 returns "index", :31-34 returns "index-next"). No 6.2.x open-source fix exists (7.0.9 only). Revisit when Komga moves to Spring Boot 4 or adds XSLT views.

Measured 2026-11-16 on the Komga 1.30.1 source. The flaw is stream corruption when Server-Sent Events carry rendered view fragments. Komga's only SSE endpoint (komga/src/main/kotlin/org/gotson/komga/interfaces/sse/SseController.kt:45 GET sse/v1/events) sends named events whose data is JSON (SseController.kt:136-141, .data(data, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)) plus heartbeat comments (:64); it never returns ModelAndView or FragmentsRendering over SSE, and webflux serves no endpoints (see CVE-2026-47892). No 6.2.x open-source fix exists (7.0.9 only). Revisit when Komga moves to Spring Boot 4.

Measured 2026-11-16 on the Komga 1.30.1 source. The flaw is a header predicate bypass in WebFlux functional endpoints (RouterFunction). Komga runs on Spring MVC (komga/build.gradle.kts:65 spring-boot-starter-web); spring-boot-starter-webflux (:66) is only used for the reactive WebClient (komga/src/main/kotlin/org/gotson/komga/interfaces/api/rest/ReleaseController.kt:15 and AnnouncementController.kt:20 import web.reactive.function.client.WebClient), and the source defines no RouterFunction, coRouter or RequestPredicates. No 6.2.x open-source fix exists (7.0.9 only). Revisit when Komga moves to Spring Boot 4.
